records.excerpt: Hand sanitising uses an approved hand antiseptic—commonly an alcohol-based hand rub—to reduce microorganisms on hands without rinsing with water. It works best when used in the right setting and on hands that are not visibly soiled.

records.title: Hand sanitising क्या है?
records.excerpt: Hand sanitising approved hand antiseptic—commonly alcohol-based hand rub—से hands पर microorganisms reduce करती है बिना water rinse के।

records.title: When Is Hand Sanitiser Different from Handwashing?
records.excerpt: Hand sanitiser differs most from handwashing when hands are visibly dirty, when physical removal of contaminants is needed, or when healthcare guidance specifies soap and water; otherwise alcohol-based hand rub is often preferred in routine clinical care.

records.title: Hand sanitiser handwashing से कब different है?
records.excerpt: Hand sanitiser और handwashing का difference visibly dirty hands, physical contaminant removal या setting-specific soap-and-water requirements में सबसे important होता है।

records.title: Why Visible Soil Changes Hand-Hygiene Choice
records.excerpt: Visible soil changes hand-hygiene choice because alcohol-based hand sanitizer does not physically remove dirt, grease or organic material. In healthcare, visibly soiled hands should be washed with soap and water.

records.title: Visible soil hand-hygiene choice क्यों बदलती है
records.excerpt: Visible soil hand-hygiene choice बदलती है क्योंकि alcohol-based sanitizer dirt, grease या organic material physically remove नहीं करती। Healthcare में visibly soiled hands soap और water से wash करनी चाहिए।

records.title: What Is Clinical Hand Hygiene?
records.excerpt: Clinical hand hygiene is the structured cleaning of healthcare personnel's hands at defined moments before, during and after patient care to reduce transmission between patients, staff, equipment and the care environment.

records.title: Clinical hand hygiene क्या है?
records.excerpt: Clinical hand hygiene patient care के defined moments पर healthcare personnel की hands clean करने की structured practice है, ताकि patients, staff, equipment और environment के बीच transmission कम हो।

records.title: Why Hand-Hygiene Access Matters in Healthcare
records.excerpt: Hand-hygiene access matters because healthcare workers need to clean their hands at multiple defined moments during care. Supplies that are distant, blocked or unavailable create practical barriers to timely hand hygiene.

records.title: Healthcare में hand-hygiene access क्यों matter करती है
records.excerpt: Healthcare workers को care के कई defined moments पर hands clean करनी होती हैं। Distant, blocked या unavailable supplies timely hand hygiene में practical barriers बनाती हैं।

records.title: How Product Placement Supports Clinical Hand Hygiene
records.excerpt: Product placement supports clinical hand hygiene when alcohol-based hand rub is positioned at or near the point of care, supplies are visible and reachable, and placement considers workflow, maintenance and safety.

records.title: Product placement clinical hand hygiene को कैसे support करती है
records.excerpt: Clinical hand hygiene तब better supported होती है जब alcohol-based hand rub point of care के near हो, supplies visible/reachable हों और placement workflow, maintenance तथा safety consider करे।

records.title: What Should a Hand-Hygiene Station Include?
records.excerpt: A hand-hygiene station should provide the resources needed for the expected method: reliable water, soap and hygienic drying for handwashing, and appropriately placed hand rub where alcohol-based hand sanitising is used.

records.title: Hand-hygiene station में क्या include होना चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Hand-hygiene station expected method के resources provide करे: handwashing के लिए reliable water, soap और hygienic drying; और sanitising के लिए appropriately placed hand rub।

records.title: Where Should Hand-Hygiene Stations Be Positioned?
records.excerpt: Hand-hygiene stations should be positioned where the workflow creates a need for hand hygiene, with point-of-care hand rub in clinical settings and accessible handwashing resources where soap and water are required.

records.title: Hand-hygiene stations कहाँ position करनी चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Hand-hygiene stations वहाँ position हों जहाँ workflow hand hygiene की need बनाती है—clinical setting में point-of-care hand rub और washing indications के लिए accessible soap/water resources।

records.title: Why Dispenser Design Matters for Hand Hygiene
records.excerpt: Hand-hygiene dispenser design affects whether the product is easy to identify, reach, dispense and maintain without contamination, leakage, missed doses or avoidable workflow friction.

records.title: Hand hygiene के लिए dispenser design क्यों matter करती है
records.excerpt: Hand-hygiene dispenser design affect करती है कि product identify, reach, dispense और maintain करना कितना easy है—बिना contamination, leakage या avoidable workflow friction के।

records.title: Bulk Refill vs Sealed Cartridge Systems: What Changes?
records.excerpt: Bulk-refill and sealed-cartridge systems differ in refill handling, dispenser cleaning, contamination controls, stock format, waste and compatibility. Neither should be managed as a simple top-up task.

records.title: Bulk refill vs sealed cartridge systems: क्या बदलता है?
records.excerpt: Bulk-refill और sealed-cartridge systems refill handling, dispenser cleaning, contamination controls, stock format, waste और compatibility में differ करती हैं। दोनों simple top-up task नहीं हैं।

records.title: What Is a Facility Hand-Hygiene Program?
records.excerpt: A facility hand-hygiene program is a managed system that combines accessible infrastructure and supplies with procedures, training, reminders, monitoring, feedback and leadership support.

records.title: Facility hand-hygiene program क्या है?
records.excerpt: Facility hand-hygiene program accessible infrastructure और supplies को procedures, training, reminders, monitoring, feedback और leadership support से जोड़ने वाला managed system है।

records.title: Measuring Hand-Hygiene Supply Availability
records.excerpt: Measuring hand-hygiene supply availability means checking whether the correct product and supporting resources are present, usable and reachable at defined locations and times—not only whether stock exists somewhere in the facility.

records.title: Hand-hygiene supply availability को measure करना
records.excerpt: Supply availability measure करने का अर्थ correct product और supporting resources को defined place/time पर present, usable और reachable check करना है—सिर्फ facility stock count नहीं।

records.title: How Mop and Cloth Choice Affects Cleaning
records.excerpt: Mop and cloth selection affects soil removal, chemical compatibility, cross-contamination control and the time needed to clean a facility.

records.title: पोछे और कपड़े का चुनाव सफाई को कैसे प्रभावित करता है
records.excerpt: पोछे और कपड़े का चुनाव मैल हटाने, रसायन की अनुकूलता, दूषण फैलने के जोखिम और सफाई में लगने वाले समय को प्रभावित करता है।

records.title: Microfibre vs Conventional Cleaning Cloths
records.excerpt: Microfibre may improve soil pickup, but cloth selection must also account for surface, chemical compatibility, laundering and cost.

records.title: माइक्रोफाइबर और सामान्य सफाई कपड़ों की तुलना
records.excerpt: माइक्रोफाइबर कुछ कामों में अधिक मैल पकड़ सकता है, लेकिन चुनाव में सतह, रसायन, धुलाई और कुल लागत भी देखें।

records.title: Why Tool Cleanliness Matters Between Tasks
records.excerpt: A soiled mop, cloth or bucket can carry contamination into the next task; clean tools and clear changeover rules are part of the cleaning method.

records.title: अलग-अलग कामों के बीच उपकरणों की सफाई क्यों जरूरी है
records.excerpt: गंदा पोछा, कपड़ा या बाल्टी अगले काम में दूषण पहुँचा सकती है; साफ उपकरण और बदलने के स्पष्ट नियम सफाई विधि का हिस्सा हैं।

records.title: What Makes a Cleaning Cart Well Organised?
records.excerpt: A well-organised cleaning cart carries the right supplies, separates clean from used items and makes the approved workflow easy to follow.

records.title: सफाई ट्रॉली को व्यवस्थित क्या बनाता है?
records.excerpt: व्यवस्थित सफाई ट्रॉली में सही सामान होता है, साफ और इस्तेमाल की सामग्री अलग रहती है और स्वीकृत कार्यप्रवाह अपनाना आसान होता है।

records.title: Why Cleaning-Cart Layout Affects Workflow
records.excerpt: Cart layout can reduce wasted movement, help staff find the correct supplies and reinforce the separation of clean and used materials.

records.title: सफाई ट्रॉली का विन्यास काम के प्रवाह को क्यों प्रभावित करता है
records.excerpt: ट्रॉली का सही विन्यास अनावश्यक आवाजाही घटाता है, सही सामान जल्दी ढूँढ़ने में मदद करता है और साफ तथा इस्तेमाल की सामग्री अलग रखता है।

records.title: What Is a Scrubber Dryer?
records.excerpt: A scrubber dryer combines wet scrubbing and dirty-water recovery so a hard floor can be cleaned and left substantially drier in one machine pass.

records.title: स्क्रबर-ड्रायर क्या है?
records.excerpt: स्क्रबर-ड्रायर एक ही मशीन में गीली स्क्रबिंग और गंदे पानी की रिकवरी को जोड़ता है, जिससे कठोर फर्श साफ होकर अपेक्षाकृत जल्दी सूख सकता है।

records.title: Machine Floor Cleaning vs Manual Mopping
records.excerpt: Machine cleaning and manual mopping solve different floor-care problems; area size, access, soil and water recovery should guide the choice.

records.title: मशीन से फर्श की सफाई बनाम हाथ से पोछा
records.excerpt: मशीन से सफाई और हाथ से पोछा अलग जरूरतें पूरी करते हैं; क्षेत्र का आकार, पहुँच, गंदगी और पानी की रिकवरी सही तरीका चुनने में मदद करते हैं।

records.title: Why Scrubber Dryers Can Leave Streaks or Water Behind
records.excerpt: Streaks or residual water usually point to a recovery problem, setup issue, debris, wear or operating condition that should be checked systematically.

records.title: स्क्रबर-ड्रायर धारियाँ या पानी क्यों छोड़ सकता है
records.excerpt: धारियाँ या बचा पानी अक्सर रिकवरी समस्या, गलत सेटअप, मलबे, घिसाव या संचालन की स्थिति की ओर संकेत करते हैं।

records.title: How Vacuum Cleaning and Extraction Cleaning Differ
records.excerpt: Vacuuming primarily removes loose dry soil, while extraction cleaning uses liquid to loosen embedded soil and then recovers the contaminated solution.

records.title: वैक्यूम सफाई और एक्सट्रैक्शन सफाई में क्या अंतर है
records.excerpt: वैक्यूम मुख्यतः ढीली सूखी गंदगी हटाता है, जबकि एक्सट्रैक्शन में तरल से जमी गंदगी ढीली कर दूषित घोल को वापस खींचा जाता है।

records.title: What Is Carpet Extraction Cleaning?
records.excerpt: Carpet extraction cleaning is a wet-cleaning process that applies solution, loosens soil and recovers the contaminated liquid with suction.

records.title: कार्पेट एक्सट्रैक्शन सफाई क्या है?
records.excerpt: कार्पेट एक्सट्रैक्शन एक गीली सफाई प्रक्रिया है जिसमें घोल लगाया जाता है, गंदगी ढीली की जाती है और दूषित तरल को सक्शन से वापस लिया जाता है।

records.title: Why Suction and Recovery Matter in Extraction Cleaning
records.excerpt: Extraction cleaning depends not only on applying solution, but on recovering that liquid efficiently so loosened soil and excess moisture leave the carpet.

records.title: एक्सट्रैक्शन सफाई में सक्शन और रिकवरी क्यों महत्वपूर्ण हैं
records.excerpt: एक्सट्रैक्शन सफाई केवल घोल लगाने पर निर्भर नहीं करती; ढीली गंदगी और अतिरिक्त नमी हटाने के लिए तरल की प्रभावी रिकवरी भी जरूरी है।

records.title: What Is a Chemical Dispensing System?
records.excerpt: A chemical dispensing system prepares a use solution by delivering a controlled amount of concentrate and diluent according to a defined setup.

records.title: केमिकल डिस्पेंसिंग सिस्टम क्या है?
records.excerpt: केमिकल डिस्पेंसिंग सिस्टम निर्धारित सेटअप के अनुसार कंसन्ट्रेट और डाइल्यूएंट की नियंत्रित मात्रा देकर उपयोग-योग्य घोल तैयार करता है।

records.title: Why Controlled Dosing Improves Consistency
records.excerpt: Controlled dosing reduces variation in solution preparation by making the concentrate-to-water ratio more repeatable than unstructured manual mixing.

records.title: नियंत्रित डोजिंग से निरंतरता क्यों बेहतर होती है
records.excerpt: नियंत्रित डोजिंग कंसन्ट्रेट और पानी के अनुपात को दोहराने योग्य बनाकर हाथ से मिलाने की भिन्नता घटाती है।

records.title: Why Dosing Systems Deliver Inconsistent Results
records.excerpt: Inconsistent dosing can result from product, water, setup, wear, blockage or calibration problems; a structured check is safer than guessing at concentration.

records.title: डोजिंग सिस्टम असंगत परिणाम क्यों देते हैं
records.excerpt: असंगत डोजिंग उत्पाद, पानी, सेटअप, घिसाव, रुकावट या कैलिब्रेशन समस्या से हो सकती है; अनुमान लगाने के बजाय क्रमबद्ध जाँच बेहतर है।

records.title: Why Cleaning Equipment Needs Preventive Maintenance
records.excerpt: Preventive maintenance keeps cleaning equipment safe, hygienic and predictable by finding wear, blockage, damage and service needs before they become failures.

records.title: सफाई उपकरण को प्रिवेंटिव मेंटेनेंस क्यों चाहिए
records.excerpt: प्रिवेंटिव मेंटेनेंस घिसाव, रुकावट, नुकसान और सेवा जरूरत को खराबी बनने से पहले पहचानकर उपकरण को सुरक्षित, स्वच्छ और भरोसेमंद रखता है।

records.title: What Should an Equipment Maintenance Log Track?
records.excerpt: A useful maintenance log records equipment identity, inspection dates, findings, work performed, parts changed, faults, downtime and who completed or approved the work.

records.title: उपकरण मेंटेनेंस लॉग में क्या दर्ज होना चाहिए?
records.excerpt: अच्छा मेंटेनेंस लॉग उपकरण की पहचान, निरीक्षण तिथि, स्थिति, किए गए काम, बदले भाग, खराबी, डाउनटाइम और जिम्मेदार व्यक्ति को दर्ज करता है।

records.title: Why Cleaning Equipment Performance Declines Over Time
records.excerpt: Cleaning-machine performance often declines gradually as wear, contamination, blockage, battery condition, adjustment and neglected maintenance change how the system works.

records.title: समय के साथ सफाई उपकरण का प्रदर्शन क्यों घटता है
records.excerpt: घिसाव, गंदगी, रुकावट, बैटरी स्थिति, समायोजन और टला हुआ रखरखाव धीरे-धीरे सफाई मशीन के प्रदर्शन को कम कर सकते हैं।

records.title: Troubleshooting Inconsistent Machine-Cleaning Results
records.excerpt: Inconsistent machine-cleaning results are easier to diagnose when you separate the problem into surface, soil, chemistry, setup, operator, recovery and equipment-condition checks.

records.title: मशीन सफाई के असंगत परिणामों की ट्रबलशूटिंग
records.excerpt: असंगत मशीन सफाई परिणामों को सतह, गंदगी, रसायन, सेटअप, ऑपरेटर, रिकवरी और उपकरण स्थिति के क्रम में जाँचकर आसान बनाया जा सकता है।

records.title: What Is Cleaning Chemistry?
records.excerpt: Cleaning chemistry is the controlled use of water, detergents and other functional ingredients to loosen, dissolve, suspend or remove soil without unnecessarily damaging the surface.

records.title: क्लीनिंग केमिस्ट्री क्या है?
records.excerpt: क्लीनिंग केमिस्ट्री पानी, डिटर्जेंट और अन्य कार्यात्मक घटकों का नियंत्रित उपयोग है, जिससे सतह को अनावश्यक नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना गंदगी ढीली, घुली, निलंबित या हटाई जा सके।

records.title: How Cleaning Products Remove Soil
records.excerpt: Cleaning products remove soil through several mechanisms, including wetting, dissolving, emulsifying, suspending and controlling water conditions so soil can be separated from a surface.

records.title: सफाई उत्पाद गंदगी कैसे हटाते हैं
records.excerpt: सफाई उत्पाद वेटिंग, घुलने, इमल्सीफिकेशन, सस्पेंशन और पानी की स्थिति नियंत्रित करने जैसी प्रक्रियाओं से गंदगी को सतह से अलग करने में मदद करते हैं।

records.title: Why One Cleaner Cannot Suit Every Soil and Surface
records.excerpt: A cleaner that works on one soil and surface may perform poorly or cause damage elsewhere because soil chemistry, material compatibility and required cleaning conditions differ.

records.title: एक ही क्लीनर हर गंदगी और सतह के लिए क्यों उपयुक्त नहीं हो सकता
records.excerpt: एक क्लीनर किसी एक गंदगी और सतह पर अच्छा काम कर सकता है लेकिन दूसरी जगह खराब प्रदर्शन या नुकसान कर सकता है, क्योंकि रसायन और सामग्री की अनुकूलता अलग होती है।

records.title: Professional Cleaning Formulations vs Single Ingredients
records.excerpt: Professional cleaning formulations combine ingredients with different functions so wetting, soil removal, water control, stability and safe use can be managed as one product system.

records.title: पेशेवर क्लीनिंग फॉर्म्युलेशन बनाम एकल घटक
records.excerpt: पेशेवर क्लीनिंग फॉर्म्युलेशन अलग कार्य वाले कई घटकों को जोड़ते हैं ताकि वेटिंग, गंदगी हटाना, पानी नियंत्रण, स्थिरता और सुरक्षित उपयोग एक ही उत्पाद सिस्टम में प्रबंधित हो सके।

records.title: What Is pH in Cleaning Chemicals?
records.excerpt: pH describes how acidic or alkaline an aqueous cleaning solution is; it influences product behaviour and compatibility but does not by itself predict cleaning power or safety.

records.title: क्लीनिंग केमिकल्स में pH क्या है?
records.excerpt: pH बताता है कि पानी-आधारित सफाई घोल कितना अम्लीय या क्षारीय है; यह व्यवहार और अनुकूलता को प्रभावित करता है, लेकिन अकेले सफाई शक्ति या सुरक्षा तय नहीं करता।

records.title: Acidic vs Alkaline Cleaners
records.excerpt: Acidic and alkaline cleaners occupy different parts of the pH scale and can suit different soils and surfaces, but pH alone does not determine cleaning performance or safety.

records.title: अम्लीय बनाम क्षारीय क्लीनर
records.excerpt: अम्लीय और क्षारीय क्लीनर pH स्केल के अलग हिस्सों में होते हैं और अलग गंदगी तथा सतह के लिए उपयोगी हो सकते हैं, लेकिन pH अकेले सफाई प्रदर्शन या सुरक्षा तय नहीं करता।

records.title: Does Higher pH Mean a Stronger Cleaner?
records.excerpt: A higher pH does not automatically mean a cleaner is more powerful; cleaning performance depends on the whole formulation, soil, surface, concentration and process.

records.title: क्या ऊँचा pH मतलब ज्यादा शक्तिशाली क्लीनर है?
records.excerpt: ऊँचा pH अपने आप किसी क्लीनर को ज्यादा शक्तिशाली नहीं बनाता; प्रदर्शन पूरे फॉर्म्युलेशन, गंदगी, सतह, कंसन्ट्रेशन और प्रक्रिया पर निर्भर करता है।

records.title: What Is a Neutral Cleaner?
records.excerpt: A neutral cleaner is a detergent formulated close to neutral pH, often chosen for routine cleaning where broad surface compatibility and controlled soil removal are priorities.

records.title: न्यूट्रल क्लीनर क्या है?
records.excerpt: न्यूट्रल क्लीनर लगभग न्यूट्रल pH पर फॉर्म्युलेट किया गया डिटर्जेंट है, जिसे अक्सर नियमित सफाई और व्यापक सतह अनुकूलता के लिए चुना जाता है।

records.title: What Are Surfactants?
records.excerpt: Surfactants are functional ingredients that reduce surface tension and help cleaning solutions wet surfaces, interact with soil and keep loosened material dispersed for removal.

records.title: सर्फैक्टेंट क्या हैं?
records.excerpt: सर्फैक्टेंट ऐसे कार्यात्मक घटक हैं जो सतही तनाव कम करते हैं और सफाई घोल को सतह भिगोने, गंदगी से संपर्क करने और ढीली सामग्री को हटाने तक फैलाए रखने में मदद करते हैं।

records.title: How Surfactants Help Water Spread
records.excerpt: Surfactants help water spread by lowering surface tension, allowing cleaning solution to wet a surface more evenly and make better contact with soil.

records.title: सर्फैक्टेंट पानी को फैलने में कैसे मदद करते हैं
records.excerpt: सर्फैक्टेंट सतही तनाव कम करके पानी-आधारित सफाई घोल को सतह पर अधिक समान रूप से फैलने और गंदगी से बेहतर संपर्क करने में मदद करते हैं।

records.title: Anionic vs Nonionic vs Cationic Surfactants
records.excerpt: Anionic, nonionic and cationic surfactants differ in the electrical character of their water-interacting region, which influences cleaning behaviour, compatibility and formulation design.

records.title: Anionic, Nonionic और Cationic सर्फैक्टेंट में अंतर
records.excerpt: Anionic, nonionic और cationic सर्फैक्टेंट अपने पानी से संपर्क करने वाले हिस्से के विद्युत गुण में अलग होते हैं, जिससे सफाई व्यवहार, अनुकूलता और फॉर्म्युलेशन डिज़ाइन प्रभावित होता है.

records.title: Why Foam Does Not Always Equal Cleaning Power
records.excerpt: Foam is a visible property of a cleaning solution, but the amount of foam does not directly measure how well the product removes soil.

records.title: झाग हमेशा सफाई शक्ति क्यों नहीं बताता
records.excerpt: झाग सफाई घोल का दिखाई देने वाला गुण है, लेकिन झाग की मात्रा सीधे यह नहीं बताती कि उत्पाद गंदगी कितनी अच्छी तरह हटाता है.

records.title: What Are Disinfectant Active Ingredients?
records.excerpt: Disinfectant active ingredients are the antimicrobial chemicals in a registered product that support its labeled claims against specified microorganisms under defined conditions.

records.title: डिसइन्फेक्टेंट active ingredients क्या होते हैं?
records.excerpt: Disinfectant active ingredients registered उत्पाद के वे antimicrobial chemicals हैं जो निर्धारित conditions में specific microorganisms के खिलाफ labeled claims का आधार बनते हैं.

records.title: What Are Quaternary Ammonium Compounds?
records.excerpt: Quaternary ammonium compounds are a chemical family that includes cationic surfactants and active ingredients used in many registered low-level environmental disinfectants.

records.title: Quaternary Ammonium Compounds क्या हैं?
records.excerpt: Quaternary ammonium compounds एक chemical family है जिसमें cationic surfactants और कई registered low-level environmental disinfectants में उपयोग होने वाले active ingredients शामिल हैं.

records.title: Phenolic vs Quaternary Disinfectants
records.excerpt: Phenolic and quaternary disinfectants are different regulated chemical families; this overview explains the distinction without ranking products or giving handling instructions.

records.title: Phenolic बनाम Quaternary Disinfectants
records.excerpt: Phenolic और quaternary disinfectants अलग regulated chemical families हैं; यह overview बिना ranking या handling instructions दिए उनका सामान्य अंतर समझाता है.

records.title: What Are Enzymes in Cleaning Products?
records.excerpt: Enzymes are specialised proteins used in some cleaning formulations to help break down particular types of organic soil into smaller, more removable materials.

records.title: Cleaning Products में Enzymes क्या होते हैं?
records.excerpt: Enzymes विशेष proteins हैं जो कुछ cleaning formulations में खास प्रकार की organic soil को छोटे और अधिक आसानी से हटने वाले पदार्थों में तोड़ने में मदद करते हैं.

records.title: How Enzymes Target Different Soil Types
records.excerpt: Different enzyme families act on different kinds of organic material, so cleaning formulations may use selected enzymes to address proteins, starches, fats or other targeted soils.

records.title: Enzymes अलग Soil Types को कैसे Target करते हैं
records.excerpt: अलग enzyme families अलग organic materials पर काम करती हैं, इसलिए cleaning formulations proteins, starches, fats या दूसरी targeted soils के लिए अलग enzymes चुन सकते हैं.

records.title: Why Enzyme Performance Depends on Conditions
records.excerpt: Enzyme activity depends on formulation and environmental conditions such as pH, temperature, water, stability and the type of soil being targeted.

records.title: Enzyme Performance Conditions पर क्यों निर्भर करता है
records.excerpt: Enzyme activity formulation और pH, temperature, water, stability तथा target soil जैसी conditions पर निर्भर करती है.

records.title: What Is an Oxidising Cleaner?
records.excerpt: An oxidising cleaner contains chemistry that changes certain soils or stains through oxidation; because oxidisers can also affect materials and present hazards, finished products must be used only as labeled.

records.title: Oxidising Cleaner क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Oxidising cleaner ऐसी chemistry वाला product है जो oxidation के जरिए कुछ soils या stains को बदलता है; oxidisers materials और safety को भी प्रभावित कर सकते हैं, इसलिए finished products केवल label के अनुसार उपयोग होने चाहिए.

records.title: Bleach Product Categories: Safety and Label Guidance
records.excerpt: This safety-focused overview explains that bleach products can belong to different oxidising categories and that their labels, hazards, and compatibility requirements are product-specific.

records.title: Bleach Product Categories: Safety और Label Guidance
records.excerpt: यह safety-focused overview बताता है कि bleach products अलग oxidising categories में हो सकते हैं और labels, hazards तथा compatibility requirements product-specific होते हैं.

records.title: Why Oxidisers Can Affect Colour and Materials
records.excerpt: Oxidising cleaners can alter stains but can also affect dyes, finishes, metals and other materials, so compatibility depends on the exact product and surface.

records.title: Oxidisers Colour और Materials को क्यों प्रभावित कर सकते हैं
records.excerpt: Oxidising cleaners stains को बदल सकते हैं, लेकिन dyes, finishes, metals और अन्य materials को भी प्रभावित कर सकते हैं; compatibility exact product और surface पर निर्भर करती है.

records.title: What Is a Cleaning-Chemical Concentrate?
records.excerpt: A cleaning-chemical concentrate is a product supplied at a higher ingredient concentration than its intended use solution and designed to be prepared only according to its label or approved dispensing system.

records.title: Cleaning-Chemical Concentrate क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Cleaning-chemical concentrate ऐसा product है जो intended use solution की तुलना में अधिक concentrated form में supply होता है और केवल label या approved dispensing system के अनुसार prepare किया जाना चाहिए.

records.title: Concentrate vs Ready-to-Use Cleaner
records.excerpt: Concentrated and ready-to-use cleaners are different product formats; the key distinction is whether the finished product requires an approved preparation step before routine use.

records.title: Concentrate और Ready-to-Use Cleaner में अंतर
records.excerpt: Concentrated और ready-to-use cleaners अलग product formats हैं; मुख्य अंतर यह है कि routine use से पहले approved preparation step की जरूरत है या नहीं.

records.title: Why Over-Concentration Can Reduce Cleaning Quality
records.excerpt: Using more cleaning concentrate than a product is designed for can increase residue, interfere with rinsing or recovery, affect surfaces and create unnecessary exposure without improving cleaning.

records.title: Over-Concentration Cleaning Quality क्यों घटा सकता है
records.excerpt: Product design से अधिक cleaning concentrate उपयोग करने पर residue, rinsing या recovery problems, surface effects और unnecessary exposure बढ़ सकते हैं, बिना cleaning बेहतर किए.

records.title: What Is Water Hardness?
records.excerpt: Water hardness is mainly a measure of dissolved calcium and magnesium, and it can influence soap behaviour, scale formation and how cleaning formulations perform.

records.title: Water Hardness क्या है?
records.excerpt: Water hardness मुख्य रूप से dissolved calcium और magnesium का measure है, और यह soap behaviour, scale formation तथा cleaning formulations के performance को प्रभावित कर सकता है.

records.title: How Hard Water Affects Cleaning
records.excerpt: Hard water contains higher levels of dissolved calcium and magnesium, which can interfere with some cleaning processes, contribute to residues and increase mineral deposition.

records.title: Hard Water Cleaning को कैसे प्रभावित करता है
records.excerpt: Hard water में dissolved calcium और magnesium अधिक होते हैं, जो कुछ cleaning processes में बाधा डाल सकते हैं, residue बढ़ा सकते हैं और mineral deposits बना सकते हैं.

records.title: Why Scale Forms on Surfaces
records.excerpt: Scale forms when dissolved minerals become less soluble or are left behind as water heats or evaporates, creating deposits on surfaces and equipment.

records.title: Surfaces पर Scale क्यों बनती है
records.excerpt: Scale तब बनती है जब dissolved minerals कम soluble हो जाते हैं या water heat/evaporation के बाद surface पर रह जाते हैं, जिससे deposits बनते हैं.

records.title: Cleaning Products, Soil, and Surface Compatibility
records.excerpt: Cleaning chemistry has to be compatible with both the soil being removed and the surface being protected; this overview explains those factors without recommending products.

records.title: Cleaning Products, Soil और Surface Compatibility
records.excerpt: Cleaning chemistry को soil और protected surface दोनों के साथ compatible होना चाहिए; यह overview बिना product recommendation के उन factors को समझाता है.

records.title: Cleaning Tasks and Product Labels: Why Context Matters
records.excerpt: Cleaning tasks create different surface, claim, compatibility and safety requirements; this overview explains why labels must be read in context.

records.title: Cleaning Tasks और Product Labels: Context क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है
records.excerpt: अलग cleaning tasks में surface, claim, compatibility और safety requirements अलग हो सकती हैं; यह overview बताता है कि labels को context में क्यों पढ़ना चाहिए.

records.title: General-Purpose and Task-Specific Cleaners: Label Context
records.excerpt: General-purpose and task-specific are product-role labels; this overview explains the distinction without ranking products or advising which chemistry to use.

records.title: General-Purpose और Task-Specific Cleaners: Label Context
records.excerpt: General-purpose और task-specific product-role labels हैं; यह overview बिना ranking या chemistry-use advice के उनका distinction समझाता है.

records.title: Cleaning Strength Is Not a Product-Quality Scale
records.excerpt: A more aggressive cleaning product is not automatically a better product; compatibility, task fit, safety and label-defined use matter more than perceived strength.

records.title: Cleaning Strength Product Quality का Scale नहीं है
records.excerpt: अधिक aggressive cleaning product अपने आप बेहतर product नहीं होता; compatibility, task fit, safety और label-defined use perceived strength से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण हैं.

records.title: What Is Cleaning-Chemical Compatibility?
records.excerpt: Cleaning-chemical compatibility describes whether a finished product can be used within its labeled conditions without unacceptable effects on the surface, equipment or approved process.

records.title: Cleaning-Chemical Compatibility क्या है?
records.excerpt: Cleaning-chemical compatibility यह बताती है कि finished product labeled conditions में surface, equipment या approved process पर unacceptable effects के बिना use हो सकता है या नहीं.

records.title: Why Product and Surface Compatibility Must Align
records.excerpt: A cleaning product can only be suitable when its labeled use and the material limits of the surface or equipment are compatible.

records.title: Product और Surface Compatibility क्यों Align होनी चाहिए
records.excerpt: Cleaning product तभी suitable हो सकता है जब उसका labeled use और surface या equipment की material limits compatible हों.

records.title: Contact Time, Frequency and Material Compatibility
records.excerpt: Contact time and cleaning frequency are label- and process-defined conditions that can influence both intended performance and long-term material compatibility.

records.title: Contact Time, Frequency और Material Compatibility
records.excerpt: Contact time और cleaning frequency label- तथा process-defined conditions हैं जो intended performance और long-term material compatibility दोनों को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं.

records.title: What Is a Safety Data Sheet?
records.excerpt: A Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is a standardized workplace hazard-information document that summarizes a chemical product's identity, hazards, handling controls and other safety information.

records.title: Safety Data Sheet क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) एक standardized workplace hazard-information document है जो chemical product की identity, hazards, controls और अन्य safety information summarize करता है.

records.title: How to Read the Main Sections of an SDS
records.excerpt: The 16-section SDS format groups chemical identity, hazards, controls, physical properties and other information into a consistent sequence for workplace reference.

records.title: SDS के Main Sections कैसे समझें
records.excerpt: 16-section SDS format chemical identity, hazards, controls, physical properties और अन्य information को consistent sequence में organize करता है.

records.title: SDS vs Product Label: Key Differences
records.excerpt: An SDS is a detailed workplace hazard-information document, while a product label communicates information on or with the product and may carry legally enforceable directions for regulated products.

records.title: SDS और Product Label में मुख्य अंतर
records.excerpt: SDS detailed workplace hazard-information document है, जबकि product label product के साथ information communicate करता है और regulated products में legally enforceable directions रख सकता है.

records.title: What Is a Technical Data Sheet?
records.excerpt: A Technical Data Sheet (TDS) is manufacturer technical documentation that commonly summarizes product properties, intended applications and performance information; unlike an SDS, its format is not standardized by OSHA.

records.title: Technical Data Sheet क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Technical Data Sheet (TDS) manufacturer technical documentation है जो product properties, intended applications और performance information summarize कर सकता है; SDS के unlike इसका format OSHA standardized नहीं करता.

records.title: TDS vs SDS: Key Differences
records.excerpt: A TDS is manufacturer technical documentation, while an SDS is the standardized workplace hazard-information document required under OSHA's Hazard Communication framework for covered hazardous chemicals.

records.title: TDS और SDS में मुख्य अंतर
records.excerpt: TDS manufacturer technical documentation है, जबकि SDS covered hazardous chemicals के लिए OSHA Hazard Communication framework का standardized workplace hazard-information document है.

records.title: What Should a Cleaning-Chemical TDS Contain?
records.excerpt: A cleaning-chemical TDS commonly summarizes product identity, technical properties, intended applications, compatibility notes and document-control information, while leaving regulated hazard communication to the SDS.

records.title: Cleaning-Chemical TDS में क्या होना चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Cleaning-chemical TDS आम तौर पर product identity, technical properties, intended applications, compatibility notes और document-control information summarize करता है; regulated hazard communication SDS का role रहता है.

records.title: What Is a Cleaning SOP?
records.excerpt: A cleaning SOP is a controlled set of written instructions that documents how a routine cleaning activity is organized and carried out within a specific facility or program.

records.title: Cleaning SOP क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Cleaning SOP written instructions का controlled set है जो specific facility या program में routine cleaning activity को organize और carry out करने का documented तरीका बताता है.

records.title: Why SOPs Improve Cleaning Consistency
records.excerpt: SOPs improve consistency by reducing variation in how recurring work is performed, documenting approved expectations and giving teams a common reference for training and quality review.

records.title: SOPs Cleaning Consistency क्यों Improve करते हैं
records.excerpt: SOPs recurring work में variation कम करके, approved expectations document करके और training तथा quality review के लिए common reference देकर consistency improve करते हैं.

records.title: SOP vs Checklist: Key Differences
records.excerpt: An SOP documents the approved process and its context, while a checklist is a shorter verification tool used to confirm that defined items or steps have been addressed.

records.title: SOP और Checklist में मुख्य अंतर
records.excerpt: SOP approved process और उसका context document करता है, जबकि checklist shorter verification tool है जो confirm करता है कि defined items या steps address हुए हैं.

records.title: What Is a Product Usage Guide?
records.excerpt: A product usage guide is a supporting manufacturer or facility document that explains the intended application context and points users to the controlling label, SDS, TDS or SOP where applicable.

records.title: Product Usage Guide क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Product usage guide supporting manufacturer या facility document है जो intended application context explain करता है और applicable label, SDS, TDS या SOP की ओर users को point करता है.

records.title: Usage Guide vs SOP: Key Differences
records.excerpt: A usage guide explains product context and points users to controlling documents; an SOP defines the approved, repeatable steps an organization expects for a specific task.

records.title: Usage Guide और SOP में मुख्य अंतर
records.excerpt: Usage guide product context समझाता है और controlling documents की ओर point करता है; SOP किसी specific task के लिए organization की approved, repeatable process को define करता है।

records.title: How to Read a Professional Cleaning-Chemical Label
records.excerpt: Read a professional cleaning-chemical label by confirming the product identifier, then reviewing the signal word, hazard statements, pictograms, precautionary statements and supplier information as one connected message.

records.title: Professional Cleaning-Chemical Label कैसे पढ़ें
records.excerpt: Professional cleaning-chemical label पढ़ते समय पहले product identifier confirm करें, फिर signal word, hazard statements, pictograms, precautionary statements और supplier information को एक connected message की तरह पढ़ें।

records.title: Why Product Labels Matter at the Point of Use
records.excerpt: Product labels matter at the point of use because they keep product identity and essential hazard information physically connected to the container where work decisions are made.

records.title: Point of Use पर Product Labels क्यों महत्वपूर्ण हैं
records.excerpt: Point of use पर product labels इसलिए महत्वपूर्ण हैं क्योंकि वे product identity और essential hazard information को उसी container से physically connected रखते हैं जहाँ work decisions लिए जाते हैं।

records.title: Damaged or Missing Product Labels: What to Check
records.excerpt: If a professional cleaning-chemical label is damaged or missing, verify product identity, label legibility, matching SDS information and the facility's approved relabeling process before routine use continues.

records.title: Damaged या Missing Product Label: क्या Check करें
records.excerpt: यदि professional cleaning-chemical label damaged या missing है, तो routine use जारी होने से पहले product identity, legibility, matching SDS और facility की approved relabeling process verify करें।

records.title: What Is GHS Hazard Communication?
records.excerpt: GHS is a United Nations framework for classifying chemical hazards and communicating them through harmonized label elements and safety data sheets; jurisdictions adopt it through their own rules.

records.title: GHS Hazard Communication क्या है?
records.excerpt: GHS United Nations का framework है जो chemical hazards classify करने और harmonized label elements तथा safety data sheets के through communicate करने के लिए बनाया गया है; jurisdictions इसे अपने rules के through adopt करते हैं।

records.title: What Do GHS Pictograms Mean?
records.excerpt: GHS pictograms are diamond-shaped hazard symbols used on chemical labels to communicate specific physical, health and environmental hazards at a glance.

records.title: GHS Pictograms का क्या मतलब है?
records.excerpt: GHS pictograms chemical labels पर दिए जाने वाले diamond-shaped hazard symbols हैं, जो physical, health और environmental hazards को जल्दी पहचानने में मदद करते हैं।

records.title: GHS Signal Words, Hazard & Precautionary Statements
records.excerpt: GHS labels use signal words, hazard statements and precautionary statements together to show how serious a classified hazard is, what the hazard is, and what protective actions are recommended.

records.title: GHS Signal Words, Hazard और Precautionary Statements
records.excerpt: GHS labels signal words, hazard statements और precautionary statements को साथ use करते हैं ताकि hazard की relative severity, उसकी nature और recommended protective actions clear हों।

records.title: How PPE Fits Into Chemical Risk Control
records.excerpt: PPE is one layer of workplace risk control: it protects the worker from remaining exposure, but it should be selected through hazard assessment and used with stronger controls where feasible.

records.title: Chemical Risk Control में PPE की भूमिका
records.excerpt: PPE workplace risk control की एक layer है: यह remaining exposure से worker को protect करता है, लेकिन इसे hazard assessment के आधार पर select करना चाहिए और stronger controls के साथ use करना चाहिए।

records.title: Why PPE Requirements Differ Between Cleaning Tasks
records.excerpt: PPE requirements differ because workplace tasks, products and environments are not identical; selection should follow the documented hazard assessment and applicable safety information.

records.title: Cleaning Tasks में PPE Requirements अलग क्यों होती हैं?
records.excerpt: PPE requirements अलग होती हैं क्योंकि workplace tasks, products और environments identical नहीं होते; selection documented hazard assessment और applicable safety information के अनुसार होनी चाहिए।

records.title: PPE vs Engineering Controls: Key Differences
records.excerpt: Engineering controls change the workplace or process, while PPE protects the individual worker; they reduce risk in different ways and sit at different levels in the hierarchy of controls.

records.title: PPE vs Engineering Controls: मुख्य अंतर
records.excerpt: Engineering controls workplace या process को change करते हैं, जबकि PPE individual worker को protect करता है; दोनों risk अलग तरीके से reduce करते हैं और hierarchy of controls में इनके levels अलग हैं।

records.title: Why Cleaning Chemicals Need Controlled Storage
records.excerpt: Controlled storage helps keep cleaning chemicals identifiable, separated as required, protected from misuse, and managed according to label, SDS and workplace requirements.

records.title: Cleaning Chemicals को Controlled Storage की जरूरत क्यों होती है?
records.excerpt: Controlled storage cleaning chemicals को identifiable, required तरीके से separated, misuse से protected और label, SDS तथा workplace requirements के अनुसार managed रखने में मदद करता है।

records.title: What Makes a Chemical Storage Area Well Organised?
records.excerpt: A well-organised chemical storage area supports clear identification, documented segregation, controlled access, inventory visibility and routine inspection.

records.title: Chemical Storage Area को Well Organised क्या बनाता है?
records.excerpt: Well-organised chemical storage area clear identification, documented segregation, controlled access, inventory visibility और routine inspection support करता है।

records.title: Why Incompatible Products Should Not Be Stored Together
records.excerpt: Some chemical products require separation because incompatibility can create additional hazards; storage decisions should follow documented safety information, not assumptions.

records.title: Incompatible Products को साथ Store क्यों नहीं करना चाहिए?
records.excerpt: कुछ chemical products को अलग रखना जरूरी होता है क्योंकि incompatibility additional hazards create कर सकती है; storage decisions documented safety information follow करें।

records.title: Why Facilities Need a Chemical Spill Response Plan
records.excerpt: A spill response plan defines how a facility recognises an emergency, alerts people, assigns responsibility, coordinates evacuation or outside help, and records follow-up.

records.title: Facilities को Chemical Spill Response Plan की जरूरत क्यों होती है?
records.excerpt: Spill response plan define करता है कि facility emergency कैसे recognise करेगी, लोगों को alert करेगी, responsibility assign करेगी, evacuation या outside help coordinate करेगी और follow-up record करेगी।

records.title: What Belongs in a Chemical Exposure Procedure?
records.excerpt: A chemical exposure procedure should define recognition, reporting, emergency escalation, access to product safety information, medical coordination, documentation and follow-up.

records.title: Chemical Exposure Procedure में क्या शामिल होना चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Chemical exposure procedure recognition, reporting, emergency escalation, product safety information access, medical coordination, documentation और follow-up define करे।

records.title: When Should a Chemical Incident Be Escalated?
records.excerpt: A chemical incident should be escalated whenever conditions are uncertain, worsening, beyond authorised response capability, or involve exposure, injury, fire, evacuation or outside emergency support.

records.title: Chemical Incident को कब Escalate करना चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Chemical incident को तब escalate करना चाहिए जब situation uncertain, worsening, authorised response capability से बाहर हो, या exposure, injury, fire, evacuation या outside emergency support involve करे।

records.title: What Does Hygiene Audit Readiness Mean?
records.excerpt: Hygiene audit readiness means that current procedures, records, responsibilities and evidence are maintained routinely so the facility can demonstrate how its hygiene controls operate without last-minute reconstruction.

records.title: Hygiene Audit Readiness का क्या मतलब है?
records.excerpt: Hygiene audit readiness का मतलब है कि current procedures, records, responsibilities और evidence routine तरीके से maintained हों ताकि facility last-minute reconstruction के बिना अपना hygiene system demonstrate कर सके।

records.title: Cleaning Records Commonly Reviewed in Audits
records.excerpt: Cleaning audits commonly review records that show what was planned, what was completed, what was checked, and how exceptions or corrective actions were handled; the exact record set depends on the audit scope.

records.title: Audits में Commonly Reviewed Cleaning Records
records.excerpt: Cleaning audits अक्सर ऐसे records review करते हैं जो दिखाएँ कि क्या planned था, क्या complete हुआ, क्या verify हुआ और exceptions या corrective actions कैसे handle किए गए; exact record set audit scope पर depend करता है।

records.title: Why Document Availability Matters During Audits
records.excerpt: Document availability matters because auditors need timely access to current, relevant evidence; missing, outdated or hard-to-retrieve information can weaken traceability even when work was performed correctly.

records.title: Audits के दौरान Document Availability क्यों Matter करती है?
records.excerpt: Document availability matter करती है क्योंकि auditors को current और relevant evidence timely access चाहिए; missing, outdated या difficult-to-retrieve information traceability कमजोर कर सकती है।

records.title: What Is Document Control in Facility Hygiene?
records.excerpt: Document control is the system used to create, approve, identify, update, distribute, protect, retain and retire hygiene documents and records so people use reliable information.

records.title: Facility Hygiene में Document Control क्या है?
records.excerpt: Document control वह system है जो hygiene documents और records को create, approve, identify, update, distribute, protect, retain और retire करता है ताकि people reliable information use करें।

records.title: Why Controlled Documents Need Version Management
records.excerpt: Version management helps facilities know which procedure is current, what changed, who approved it and when an older version was replaced.

records.title: Controlled Documents को Version Management की जरूरत क्यों होती है?
records.excerpt: Version management facility को यह जानने में मदद करता है कि कौन-सी procedure current है, क्या change हुआ, किसने approve किया और older version कब replace हुआ।

records.title: Preventing Obsolete Cleaning Instructions
records.excerpt: Facilities can reduce obsolete cleaning instructions by controlling approvals, distribution, replacement, access and periodic review of procedures and work instructions.

records.title: Obsolete Cleaning Instructions को कैसे Prevent करें?
records.excerpt: Facilities approvals, distribution, replacement, access और periodic review control करके obsolete cleaning instructions का risk reduce कर सकती हैं।

records.title: What Is a Facility Cleaning Plan?
records.excerpt: A facility cleaning plan defines what must be cleaned, how often, by whom, using which methods and controls, and how completion and quality will be verified.

records.title: Facility Cleaning Plan क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Facility cleaning plan यह define करता है कि क्या clean करना है, कितनी frequency पर, किसकी responsibility है, कौन-से methods और controls use होंगे, और completion व quality कैसे verify होगी।

records.title: How Cleaning Plans and Cleaning Schedules Differ
records.excerpt: A cleaning plan defines the management framework, standards and controls; a cleaning schedule converts that framework into timed, assigned tasks.

records.title: Cleaning Plan और Cleaning Schedule में क्या अंतर है?
records.excerpt: Cleaning plan management framework, standards और controls define करता है; cleaning schedule उसी framework को timed और assigned tasks में बदलता है।

records.title: How to Set Cleaning Frequencies by Risk and Use
records.excerpt: Cleaning frequency should reflect contamination risk, touch and traffic levels, occupancy, task purpose, facility use and the consequences of inadequate cleaning.

records.title: Risk और Use के आधार पर Cleaning Frequency कैसे Set करें?
records.excerpt: Cleaning frequency contamination risk, touch और traffic levels, occupancy, task purpose, facility use और inadequate cleaning के consequences पर आधारित होनी चाहिए।

records.title: What Should Cleaning Staff Training Cover?
records.excerpt: Cleaning staff training should cover task methods, hygiene principles, chemical and equipment safety, PPE, facility-specific risks, records, escalation and demonstrated competency.

records.title: Cleaning Staff Training में क्या-क्या Cover होना चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Cleaning staff training में task methods, hygiene principles, chemical और equipment safety, PPE, facility-specific risks, records, escalation और demonstrated competency शामिल होने चाहिए।

records.title: Why Task Demonstration Matters in Cleaning Training
records.excerpt: Task demonstration turns written instructions into observable practice, allowing trainers to show the correct method and verify that staff can repeat it safely and consistently.

records.title: Cleaning Training में Task Demonstration क्यों जरूरी है?
records.excerpt: Task demonstration written instructions को observable practice में बदलता है, जिससे trainer correct method दिखा सकता है और verify कर सकता है कि staff उसे safely और consistently repeat कर सकते हैं।

records.title: Induction Training vs Refresher Training
records.excerpt: Induction training prepares staff for safe initial work; refresher training reinforces, updates and corrects knowledge and practical performance after work has begun.

records.title: Induction Training और Refresher Training में क्या अंतर है?
records.excerpt: Induction training staff को safe initial work के लिए prepare करती है; refresher training काम शुरू होने के बाद knowledge और practical performance को reinforce, update और correct करती है।

records.title: What Is Cleaning Competency Assessment?
records.excerpt: Cleaning competency assessment checks whether a worker can perform required tasks correctly, safely and consistently in practice—not simply whether training was attended.

records.title: Cleaning Competency Assessment क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Cleaning competency assessment check करता है कि worker required task को practice में correctly, safely और consistently perform कर सकता है या नहीं।

records.title: Why Attendance Does Not Prove Competency
records.excerpt: Training attendance shows that a worker was present; it does not show that the worker can correctly perform the task under real operating conditions.

records.title: Training Attendance Competency क्यों Prove नहीं करती?
records.excerpt: Training attendance केवल presence show करती है; यह prove नहीं करती कि worker real operating conditions में task correctly perform कर सकता है।

records.title: How Practical Observation Supports Competency Checks
records.excerpt: Practical observation lets an assessor compare real task performance with defined criteria and identify technique, safety or consistency gaps that written tests may miss.

records.title: Practical Observation Competency Checks को कैसे Support करती है?
records.excerpt: Practical observation assessor को real task performance को defined criteria से compare करने और technique, safety या consistency gaps identify करने देता है।

records.title: What Is a Hygiene Inspection?
records.excerpt: A hygiene inspection is a structured review of areas, surfaces, tasks and records to check whether cleaning controls are being implemented and whether required standards are being maintained.

records.title: Hygiene Inspection क्या होती है?
records.excerpt: Hygiene inspection structured review है जो areas, surfaces, tasks और records check करती है ताकि पता चले कि cleaning controls implement हो रहे हैं और required standards maintain हो रहे हैं।

records.title: How Supervision Differs from Formal Auditing
records.excerpt: Supervision is continuous operational oversight; formal auditing is a structured, periodic evaluation against defined criteria with documented findings and follow-up.

records.title: Supervision और Formal Auditing में क्या अंतर है?
records.excerpt: Supervision continuous operational oversight है; formal auditing defined criteria के against structured, periodic evaluation है।

records.title: Why Inspection Criteria Need to Be Consistent
records.excerpt: Consistent inspection criteria make findings comparable, reduce assessor variation and help facilities identify real trends rather than differences in personal judgement.

records.title: Inspection Criteria Consistent क्यों होने चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Consistent inspection criteria findings को comparable बनाते हैं, assessor variation कम करते हैं और real trends identify करने में मदद करते हैं।

records.title: What Is a Facility Hygiene Audit?
records.excerpt: A facility hygiene audit is a structured evaluation of hygiene controls, records and actual practice against defined requirements to identify conformity, gaps and improvement needs.

records.title: Facility Hygiene Audit क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Facility hygiene audit hygiene controls, records और actual practice को defined requirements के against structured तरीके से evaluate करती है।

records.title: Corrective and Preventive Action in Hygiene Management
records.excerpt: Corrective and preventive action addresses causes of hygiene failures, verifies that fixes work and uses risk information to reduce the chance of recurrence or similar future problems.

records.title: Hygiene Management में Corrective और Preventive Action
records.excerpt: CAPA hygiene failures के causes address करती है, fixes की effectiveness verify करती है और recurrence या similar future problems का risk कम करती है।

records.title: Non-Conformance vs Corrective Action: Key Differences
records.excerpt: A non-conformance is a failure to meet a requirement; corrective action is the structured response used to address the cause and reduce the chance of recurrence.

records.title: Non-Conformance और Corrective Action में क्या अंतर है?
records.excerpt: Non-conformance requirement failure है; corrective action cause address करके recurrence का chance कम करने वाली structured response है।

records.title: Why Cleaning-Chemical Stock Control Matters
records.excerpt: Cleaning-chemical stock control helps prevent shortages, overstock, expiry, unauthorized substitution and service disruption while improving traceability and cost visibility.

records.title: Cleaning-Chemical Stock Control क्यों जरूरी है?
records.excerpt: Cleaning-chemical stock control shortages, overstock, expiry, unauthorized substitution और service disruption reduce करने में मदद करता है।

records.title: Minimum Stock vs Reorder Point: Key Differences
records.excerpt: Minimum stock is the lowest inventory level a facility intends to protect; the reorder point is the trigger level at which replenishment should be initiated.

records.title: Minimum Stock और Reorder Point में क्या अंतर है?
records.excerpt: Minimum stock protected lower inventory level है; reorder point वह trigger level है जहाँ replenishment initiate करनी चाहिए।

records.title: How Stock Visibility Reduces Cleaning Disruption
records.excerpt: Stock visibility gives supervisors early warning of shortages, supports planned replenishment and reduces emergency substitution, delayed cleaning and last-minute purchasing.

records.title: Stock Visibility Cleaning Disruption कैसे Reduce करती है?
records.excerpt: Stock visibility shortages का early warning देती है और emergency substitution, cleaning delays तथा last-minute purchasing reduce करती है।

records.title: Why Facilities Should Track Chemical Consumption
records.excerpt: Chemical-consumption tracking helps facilities understand demand, detect abnormal use, improve purchasing, investigate waste and compare cleaning costs more meaningfully.

records.title: Facilities को Chemical Consumption Track क्यों करनी चाहिए?
records.excerpt: Chemical-consumption tracking demand समझने, abnormal use detect करने, purchasing improve करने और waste investigate करने में मदद करती है।

records.title: What Is Cost per Use in Cleaning Operations?
records.excerpt: Cost per use estimates the chemical or consumable cost of completing one defined cleaning use, dose, task or service event rather than comparing pack prices alone.

records.title: Cleaning Operations में Cost per Use क्या होता है?
records.excerpt: Cost per use एक defined cleaning use, dose या task की chemical/consumable cost estimate करता है, केवल pack price compare नहीं करता।
